newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria to auction 2 floater T-bill issues Monday.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria to auction 2 floater T-bill issues Monday.

text.p: Bulgaria's Finance Ministry will offer two floating interest T-bill issues with maturities of nine and 12 months and a total par value of 14 billion levs at auctions on Monday, the central bank said.
The issues will be offered with no minimum acceptable prices set in advance.
Interest on the issues is due at maturity. It equals the central bank main interest rate for each of the issues and is adjusted every time the rate is changed by the central bank.
The main interest rate is now set at 47.28 percent annually.
Par value 7.0 bln levs 7.0 bln levs
